system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the previous relay state, and retrieved RAG context.
system_prompt_style.note: The record is ambiguous. Its name refers to the NeurIPS 2024 Mars benchmark (IfR) and its repo_url to HarryYangthu MARS, but the pinned repository evidence is fckand/MARS v1.0.0 (arXiv:2608.23918, competitive-programming relay). All cells are coded from that pinned repo and paper. Per-step prompts combine current code, subtask, starter contract, relay summary and RAG context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: local Qdrant index over algorithm-theory documents
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval is over a cp-algorithms corpus, not a code repo. There is no navigation tooling. --no-rag / USE_RAG=0 is a smoke-test option only.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: compact relay summary, not the raw public-test
context_compaction.note: The next specialist receives a compact summary of relay state instead of the full history. The mechanism was not verified in code.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Each request is a plain Chat Completions call carrying `model`, `messages`, `temperature`, `top_p`, and `max_tokens`; no server-specific fields are sent.

tool_call_format.note: No tools are sent. The model returns structured fields (action/new_code/next_agent) plus fenced code. The exact parser was not shown, so the line number is omitted.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Each request is a plain Chat Completions call carrying `model`, `messages`, `temperature`, `top_p`, and `max_tokens`; no server-specific fields are sent.
tool_count.note: No tool schemas are included in requests.

edit_primitive.note: The model emits a complete program each turn.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Each request is a plain Chat Completions call carrying `model`, `messages`, `temperature`, `top_p`, and `max_tokens`; no server-specific fields are sent.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: # select agents -> choose first -> relay loop(action/new_code/next_agent/stop)
loop_primitives.note: Each turn drafts code, runs public tests, then repairs or keeps. The outer stages are fixed: select, relay, sanitize, fixer.

planning_granularity.note: The subtask graph is stored and consulted each step via _select_relay_subtask_for_agent.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: off the draft, and forwards a structured packet
